purpose: Source reference for read-only installed-stack verification
required_before_activation: Actual Bazzite deployment and immutable running image evidence
Build-to-source binding for exact API and installed core
Required executor/config/connector surface validated in the installed environment
Late fills, cancellation, placement ambiguity, outages and restart reconciled without duplicate exposure
Installed account taker fee profile verified without sharing credentials
Exact orders/trades/held-position evidence agrees with durable Spectra journals
known_source_blockers: A running OrderExecutor can recreate a canceled order; cancellation does not mean expiry.
Late fills after cancellation can make replacement sizing exceed the original aggregate parcel.
Executor stop/cancel and indeterminate shutdown do not prove that no further venue fill exists.
Ambiguous AddOrder recovery based only on OpenOrders can miss filled accepted orders and retry placement.
The API core compatibility startup guard currently requires no fields.
The Kraken connector fee updater is a no-op; configured fee estimates do not attest the account tier.
Cached orders expire after 30 seconds; later fill updates require authoritative trade-history reconciliation.
The connector drops validate=True; it cannot be used as a no-order safeguard through the executor path.
